requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL assemble runtime objects from RuntimeInstance src/create/prototype declarations using injected code-symbol resolution.

case.given: a RuntimeInstance declaration uses src, create, or prototype
case.then: the runtime object SHALL be created through injected symbol resolution

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL call runtime factories and derive functions with the DEPA shape output = fn(runtime, input, config).

case.given: a runtime factory or derive function is invoked
case.then: the call SHALL use the runtime-first DEPA argument order

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL bind Scope.runtime declarations to runtime objects and expose the resulting scope runtime map.

case.then: the resolved runtime objects SHALL be available through that Scope runtime map

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL report recoverable runtime assembly failures as HALFCODE_RUNTIME_* diagnostics.

case.given: runtime object assembly fails in a recoverable way
case.then: the result SHALL contain a HALFCODE_RUNTIME_* diagnostic

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL 根据 DocumentOpenContext.unitInstanceId 为每个 Document occurrence 装配独立的 root Scope Runtime 与 addressable instance registry capability，并向后代 Capsule/Component occurrence Scope 提供；Unit FQN MUST NOT 代替 occurrence identity。definition lookup、registry creation 与 occurrence assembly SHALL 由 openDocument 首参 runtime 的显式 capability 提供，DocumentRuntimeConfig SHALL 保持 data-only 且 MUST NOT 包含 definitions、registry 或 function object。registry SHALL 使用 owner token 管理 register/unregister 生命周期，拒绝重复 x-id，且 MUST NOT 通过 global/WeakMap/DOM/querySelector 解析目标。

case.given: runtime-first openDocument 以唯一 unitInstanceId、definition FQN、DocumentOpenContext 和可选 hostOccurrenceRef 打开文档
case.when: 异步返回 tokenized data handle 后通过唯一 closeDocument 入口关闭
case.then: open SHALL 拒绝重复 active id并在部分失败时完全回滚；host ref SHALL 由首参 runtime 解析；close SHALL 校验 lease 并级联清理 child occurrences、Scope runtime 与 registry namespace

case.given: 两个 Document Unit instances 都注册 x-id=review-panel
case.when: 分别通过完整 unit-instance URI 解析
case.then: 两个目标 SHALL 在不同 namespace 正确解析且互不覆盖

case.given: 同一地址先卸载后重挂，旧挂载随后再次发出 unregister
case.then: 旧 unregister MUST NOT 删除新挂载实例

case.given: Document root Scope 持有 registry capability，后代 Capsule 未覆盖它
case.when: 后代 runtime 发送实例调用
case.then: 调用 SHALL 通过 Scope Runtime 可见性解析到 root registry，不直接读取全局 mutable map

case.given: 调用方以 runtime-first openDocument(runtime, input, config) 打开 Document occurrence
case.when: 系统解析 definition、创建 instance registry 并执行 occurrence assembly
case.then: 三项稳定能力 SHALL 全部取自 runtime 显式 port；input 不携带依赖，config 仅为 data-only 单次静态配置

case.given: 同一 Document FQN 被打开两次且 host runtime 相同
case.when: runtime assembly 使用两个 unitInstanceId
case.then: 系统 SHALL 产生两个独立 Scope runtime/registry namespace，嵌入 Component 的 parent SHALL 是各自 Document occurrence runtime

requirement.statement: Editable Document occurrences SHALL receive an owner-local XNL authoring session capability through Scope runtime visibility; multiple Scopes MAY share one explicitly bound session instance, while config, DOM, Presenter state and global registries MUST NOT own or resolve the writer.

case.given: A Document root Scope runtime owns an authoring session capability and a descendant Capsule or Component does not override it.
case.when: The descendant submits a document edit.
case.then: The request SHALL be delivered to the same owner-local session through runtime capability visibility.

case.given: A Document occurrence is opened in view mode, whether or not its host runtime owns an authoring factory.
case.when: The occurrence and descendant Scope/Presenter facets are assembled.
case.then: The factory SHALL NOT be invoked, no facet SHALL expose submit, and any assembly result that leaks proposal/control/session capability SHALL fail closed and roll back.

case.given: An editable Document occurrence is assembled.
case.when: Host and descendant runtime capabilities are inspected.
case.then: The host SHALL retain factory and control ports while root/Capsule/Component edit Scopes receive only the proposal port.
